source_notes: Blank-ref fill for the populated Status=shelved. GEM's status is GEM-inferred (Substatus 'inferred 2 y'); this is the first citable source actually confirming the shelved state. US ITA Mauritius Energy commercial guide (last published 2026-02-19): the 2022 CEB RFI for barge-mounted LNG power plants saw no further progress and 'as of September 2025... the project appears to be shelved.' Proposer was the state-owned Central Electricity Board (CEB) per the original lngprime article (2022-06-09, already cited in GEM). The mid-2025 CEB 'powership'/power-barge procurement that reached award on 11 Jun 2025 (RFP-CPR-2025-8770) is HFO/diesel, NOT LNG, so it does not revive this LNG terminal. Yellow because the source is secondary and hedged ('appears to be shelved'), matching the GEM-inferred status.
